purpose: Extend the already frozen no-base smartphone FGO path with the exact v1 ordinary TDCP and position/clock motion graph while retaining Pose3/velocity/bias CombinedImuFactor coupling.

split.validation_and_holdout: sealed; not materialized or opened in this phase

graph_contract.state: Pose3 body-in-local-ENU + Vector3 velocity + imuBias.ConstantBias per epoch, per-epoch receiver clock, global inter-system bias when required
graph_contract.added_factor: gtsam::CombinedImuFactor for every valid consecutive IMU interval
graph_contract.ordinary_tdcp_model: current_range + c*current_clock - previous_range - c*previous_clock - observed_delta_carrier, with the same sigma and Huber threshold as v1; Pose3 antenna position uses the existing lever-arm contract
graph_contract.motion_model: zero relative position and zero receiver-clock random walk, sigma motion_sigma_m and clock_motion_sigma_m exactly as v1; Pose3 rotation rows remain the existing loose gauge rows

observable_offset_estimator.definition: truth-free GNSS seed speed versus IMU motion-activity correlation
observable_offset_estimator.score: Pearson correlation of demeaned GNSS speed and window-mean activity
observable_offset_estimator.failure_action: apply zero offset and retain the same IMU graph; invalid/nonfinite/low-confidence estimates fail closed

input_and_frame_contract.mat_source: existing deterministic phone_data.mat converter and sealed GPST IMU CSV
input_and_frame_contract.android_units: accelerometer m/s^2; gyroscope rad/s in source MAT; converter emits loader-compatible degrees/s once
input_and_frame_contract.axis: identity raw-axis selection followed by explicit frozen taroz RzRyRx mounting [-85,178,-94] degrees
input_and_frame_contract.time: UTC milliseconds converted to GPST with +18 s; no truth-derived runtime offset

train_short_window.decision: strict route-level non-regression and strict H P95 improvement required; otherwise No-Go

gates_frozen_before_truth.promotion: development-only research result; production defaults unchanged; no validation opening on train-gate failure

source_hashes.apps/native/gnss_fgo_imu_v21.cpp: filled after implementation and before truth scoring
source_hashes.src/algorithms/fgo_gtsam_internal.hpp: filled after implementation and before truth scoring
source_hashes.src/algorithms/fgo_gtsam_backend.cpp: filled after implementation and before truth scoring
source_hashes.apps/CMakeLists.txt: filled after implementation and before truth scoring

commands.train_score: read the already permitted train truth only after the truth-free v2.1 artifacts and hashes are sealed; do not modify candidate

hash_status: Source and Release binary hashes are pinned before the single permitted train truth comparison; the record SHA256 is pinned in the companion run manifest.
